description: This file implements security-related functionalities for handling certificates in a C-based project. It includes functions for initializing, retrieving, and manipulating X509 certificates, such as fetching serial numbers, issuer, validity period, and signature algorithms. It also manages certificate paths, loads certificates from files, and integrates with a data model for certificate management within the system.

classes.name: certificate_profile
classes.description: Holds the path and the X509 certificate object for managing individual certificates.

methods.name: void init_certificate(char * path,X509 * cert,struct certificate_profile * certprofile)
methods.description: Initializes the certificate profile with a given path and X509 certificate.

methods.name: char * get_certificate_sig_alg(int sig_nid)
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm name corresponding to the given NID.

methods.name: char * generate_serial_number(const char * text,int length)
methods.description: Creates a hexadecimal string representation of the certificate's serial number.

methods.name: int fill_certificate_paths(const char * dir_path,int * cidx)
methods.description: Populates the certificate paths array by scanning a directory for certificate files.

methods.name: int get_certificate_paths(void)
methods.description: Collects certificate file paths from default and configured locations.

methods.name: int browseSecurityCertificateInst(struct dmctx * dmctx,DMNODE * parent_node,void * prev_data,char * prev_instance)
methods.description: Loads certificates from paths, creates security nodes, and integrates them into the system's data model.

methods.name: int get_Security_CertificateNumberOfEntries(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of certificate entries.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_LastModif(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_SerialNumber(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Extracts the serial number from a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_Issuer(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the issuer name of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_NotBefore(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the 'Not Before' date of the certificate validity period.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_NotAfter(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the 'Not After' date of the certificate validity period.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_Subject(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the subject name of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_SignatureAlgorithm(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm used by the certificate.
